soc-mod-01-c3.text: Robert K. Merton (1938). Social Structure and Anomie. American Sociological Review 3(5), 672-682.
soc-mod-01-c3.quote: Aberrant conduct, therefore, may be viewed as a symptom of dissociation between culturally defined aspirations and socially structured means.
soc-mod-01-c3.claim: The strain between universal goals and unequal access produces five predictable adaptations, depending on whether you accept or reject the goals and the means.
